fonts.display: 'Primary Font', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Primary Sans (custom, serif-influenced grotesque)', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Powder Blue
palette.role: Section bands, card borders, decorative dividers — the brand's secondary canvas, used to segment the page into editorial chapters without introducing contrast

palette.name: Slate Bloom
palette.role: Primary action buttons, active states — the single chromatic accent; its low saturation keeps it feeling clinical rather than commercial

palette.name: Warm Ink
palette.role: Primary text, hairline borders, card outlines, icon strokes — near-black with a warm undertone that softens the high-contrast text against white

palette.name: True Black
palette.role: Icon fills, occasional heavy borders — used sparingly for graphical weight when maximum contrast is needed

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Page background, card surfaces, text on dark blocks — the dominant canvas, never off-white or cream

palette.name: Mist Gray
palette.role: Muted helper text, secondary metadata, low-priority labels — only when a softer reading level is needed without leaving the achromatic palette
